findings.observation: Gate and Obstacle outcomes ignored longitudinal endpoint separation after a fixed step crossed the encounter. A 152 mm endpoint separation could pass a 100 mm Gate or count as a 100 mm Obstacle hit.
Rounding travel on every slice made distance depend on frame partitioning: sixty 1/60-second slices produced 10020 mm while one second produced 10000 mm.
The executable specification still described the removed 168.5-second automatic Answer.
The settings hint still described a pulse about every four seconds although auto-give had become Life-Node-aware with a 700 ms minimum cooldown.

rollback: QX-R3-003, Main, and Sites remained blocked. Remediation continued only on the isolated QX-R3-002 branch.
